decisions.reason: The gallery video Requirement already contains a complete same-message MODIFY assigning this placeholder video asset and role.
The source supplies a video asset and does not change the gallery's portfolio image collection or planned photo content.
Selecting a placeholder portfolio video does not change where the homepage portfolio tiles link.
The source identifies a placeholder video asset but does not change gallery hover-animation behavior or scope.
The supplied video is separate from the Requirement governing client-supplied website photos and their placement.
The placeholder video selection does not alter the homepage hero overlay's color, opacity, or visual emphasis.
The source has no effect on the number or presentation scope of pricing bundles.
The source selects a portfolio video and does not change the destinations of homepage section buttons.
The word placeholder refers to the video asset and has no semantic effect on the mobile pricing-table layout.
The source does not change square-footage tiers, package pricing, or the pricing model.
